Acceptable Use Policy

Rules for a safe, respectful community.

Last Updated: October 8, 2026

This Acceptable Use Policy ("AUP") governs your use of Chronica. Violations may result in account suspension or termination.

1. Respectful Behavior

  • Be civil and respectful in comments.
  • Do not harass, bully, threaten, or defame others.
  • Do not post hate speech based on race, religion, gender, or identity.

2. Prohibited Content

You may not post or share:

  • Spam, advertisements, or promotional content.
  • Sexually explicit, obscene, or violent material.
  • Content that infringes copyrights, trademarks, or privacy rights.
  • False, misleading, or defamatory information.
  • Malware, phishing links, or harmful code.

3. Platform Integrity

You may not:

  • Attempt to bypass rate limits, authentication, or security controls.
  • Use bots, scrapers, or automated scripts to access content.
  • Reverse engineer, decompile, or tamper with the platform.
  • Launch denial-of-service attacks or overload our infrastructure.

4. Account Responsibilities

  • One account per person.
  • Do not share login credentials.
  • Do not impersonate Chronica staff, editors, or other users.
  • Keep your email and password secure and up to date.

5. Reporting Violations

If you encounter content that violates this AUP, report it to sadisheikh169@gmail.com with details and screenshots (if applicable).

6. Enforcement

We may take any of the following actions for violations:

  • Warning or content removal.
  • Temporary suspension.
  • Permanent account termination.
  • Reporting to law enforcement (if illegal activity).

7. Updates

We may revise this policy. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

8. Contact

Email sadisheikh169@gmail.com.
